title: Searching track or no does not find untracked parts by their tracking
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SRCHB-U1, described ZZAUTOTEST PL SEARCH B WASHER) is untracked at {Location-A}, and none of its fields contains "track" or "no".
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SRCHB-K1) is tracked at {Location-A}, and its description contains TRACKBAR (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL SEARCH B TRACKBAR).
  • Inventory part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SRCHB-O1) is tracked at {Location-A}, and its description contains NOZZLE (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL SEARCH B NOZZLE).
  • Every ZZAUTOTEST name contains the letter t, so the single letter t cannot be checked with this case's own data; track and no stand in for part of the words.
custom_steps:
1. Type track in the Inventory search.
  2. Click the Part Number column header until it sorts Z to A.
  3. Read which of the three parts are listed.
  4. Replace the search text with no.
  5. Read which of the three parts are listed.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: {Part-B} is listed (TRACKBAR matches); {Part-A} is not listed although it is untracked; {Part-C} is not listed.
  • Step 5: {Part-C} is listed (NOZZLE matches); {Part-A} is not listed; {Part-B} is not listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S6-R2, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.4 (Finding untracked parts), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R2: “Any other term, including part of those words such as "t" or "track", matches on part number, description, tags and the other standard fields, never on tracking state.”
